title: Ter Stegen new German first-choice keeper after Neuer retirement - Yahoo Sports
content: # Ter Stegen new German first-choice keeper after Neuer retirement. Germany's goalkeeper Manuel Neuer waves before the UEFA Euro 2024 soccer match between Spain and Germany at Stuttgart Arena. Marc-André ter Stegen has praised long-time national team goalkeeper rival Manuel Neuer, whose successor as first choice between the Germany posts he is expected to become. Marc-Andre ter Stegen is Germany's new number one goalkeeper after the international retirement of Manuel Neuer, coach Julian Nagelsmann has confirmed. "Marc is the clear number one," Nagelsmann said of ter Stegen who was the obvious choice with 40 Germany caps since a 2012 debut and outstanding performances for years at Barcelona. The 32-year-old now appears set to play his first big tournament at the 2026 World Cup in the United States, Mexico and Canada. Bayern Munich's Neuer, 38, won 124 caps since a 2009 debut and played at every big tournament since the 2010 World Cup, winning the global event in 2014.

title: 2026 World Cup: Germany recall Manuel Neuer, 40, as first-choice goalkeeper - BBC Sport
content: Neuer helped Germany win the 2014 World Cup. **Bayern Munich goalkeeper Manuel Neuer has come out of international retirement to be named in Germany's squad for the 2026 World Cup, with manager Julian Nagelsmann saying the 40-year-old will be his team's number one for the tournament.**. Neuer, who has helped Bayern win the Bundesliga title and reach the Champions League semi-finals this season, won the last of his 124 caps for his country in a Euro 2024 quarter-final defeat by Spain. Neuer has played in four World Cups and is the latest of a number of players aged 40 or over to be selected for this summer's tournament, which will take place across Canada, Mexico and the United States. Who are the oldest players to feature at a World Cup? Since winning the 2014 tournament, Germany have bowed out at the group stage of the 2018 and 2022 World Cups.
